'''2005 World Championship Day 3 Drew Scott DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Drew Scott]] at [[2005 World Championship]] (Day 3), finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Michael "mc9457" Carr (2005-09-26).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35174 Worlds Day 3 - Drew Scott's 10th Enemy Has the Bomb]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071213225814/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35174 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Worlds Day 3 - Drew Scott's 10th Enemy Has the Bomb'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "mc9457" Carr
* '''Published:''' September 26, 2005
* '''Rating:''' 4.36
* '''Description:''' Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi

=== Strategy ===

The Deck that Drew Scott piloted through day 3 to win Worlds 2005 at GenCon.  Adapt your deck to what your opponent is playing from the beginning with the effects you pick to start.  Visage eats away at your opponent so their differential, if they win, is low.
